name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: LinkedIn Ads API for campaign management, reporting, and audience targeting.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0/2.1 for member authentication and token issuance.
access_notes: Requires creating a LinkedIn developer app, adding the Advertising API product, and submitting the app for LinkedIn review.
